name: dashdot
description: DESCRIPTION Dash. (or Dashdot) is a modern server dashboard, developed with a simple, but performant stack and designed with glassmorphism in mind. Live demo: https://dash.mauz.dev/ NOTES • You have other variables available to use, if needed. Check the official docs to know more. • The 'privileged' flag is needed to determine the memory and storage info. • There are two docker image tags available: 'latest' and 'dev'. VERSION 1.2 (2023-03-04)

paths.name: Storage (host)
paths.description: For reading the usage stats of all drives, and collect other information from the OS.

paths.name: Storage (OS information)
paths.description: This is the location for the OS release information (unRAID base).

variables.name: DASHDOT_SHOW_HOST
variables.description: If you want to show the host part in the server widget (e.g. dash. -> dash.mauz.io).

variables.name: DASHDOT_ACCEPT_OOKLA_EULA
variables.description: Use the newer and more accurate speedtest tool from Ookla, instead of the old speedtest-cli for your speedtests. When passing this flag, you accept Ooklas: EULA, TERMS and PRIVACY.

variables.name: DASHDOT_CUSTOM_HOST
variables.description: If you want to show a custom host in the server widget (needs DASHDOT_SHOW_HOST enabled to work).

variables.name: DASHDOT_ENABLE_CPU_TEMPS
variables.description: If you want to show the CPU temperature in the graph. This will probably not work on a VPS, so you need to try it on your own if this works. For home servers it might work just fine.

variables.name: DASHDOT_USE_IMPERIAL
variables.description: Shows any units in the imperial system, instead of the default metric.

variables.name: DASHDOT_ALWAYS_SHOW_PERCENTAGES
variables.description: To always show the current percentage of each graph in the top-left corner. Without enabling this, they will only be shown on lower resolution devices (mobile phones).

variables.name: DASHDOT_PAGE_TITLE
variables.description: If you want to show a custom string in the browser page title.

variables.name: DASHDOT_WIDGET_LIST
variables.description: The available options are: os, cpu, storage, ram, network, gpu.

variables.name: DASHDOT_OS_LABEL_LIST
variables.description: The available options are: os, arch, up_since.

variables.name: DASHDOT_CPU_LABEL_LIST
variables.description: The available options are: brand, model, cores, threads, frequency.

variables.name: DASHDOT_STORAGE_LABEL_LIST
variables.description: The available options are: brand, size, type.

variables.name: DASHDOT_RAM_LABEL_LIST
variables.description: The available options are: brand, size, type, frequency.

variables.name: DASHDOT_NETWORK_LABEL_LIST
variables.description: The available options are: type, speed_up, speed_down, interface_speed, public_ip.

variables.name: DASHDOT_GPU_LABEL_LIST
variables.description: The available options are: brand, model, memory.
